Each entry is [the name an English writer of 1790 would have used, or null if the thing was not there then; today's name, to read by; why, where they differ]. A town not listed here is not yet reviewed and is not carried into the world; one the reviewer could not date is left out rather than guessed. The rivers, keyed as world:names keys them - a Wikidata id where Natural Earth gives one, otherwise its file, number and name - reviewed on 2026-10-07: a river not listed keeps the source's name, today's, and a canal is carried only where it is listed with a name.
